entry.title: Ansible task guide
entry.why: Plan, inspect or troubleshoot a bounded Ansible change.
entry.status: Authored guidance; not an installed agent skill

briefing.purpose: Plan, inspect or troubleshoot a bounded Ansible change.
briefing.inputs: Desired state, inventory, playbook, versions and target scope.
briefing.approach: Resolve hosts, inspect side effects, validate locally and use a bounded test before rollout.
briefing.outputs: Reviewable change, observed checks and recovery plan.
briefing.requirements: Existing Ansible controller, collections and authorized target access for execution.
briefing.limits: Check mode is module-dependent; diff can reveal secrets and some tasks opt out of dry-run behavior.
briefing.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.
